name: Angelic celestial plate armor
description: celestial armor of polished {{METAL}}: two small ornate filigree plates, each in the form of a curved feather sweeping outward at the tip, covering the centre of each breast in the area of a small bikini cup, and one matching small ornate plate in the form of a small halo ring with two short feathers covering the front of the hips; every plate is engraved with fine barbs of filigree and tiny drifting stars and set with a {{GEM}} gem; each plate hangs against the skin held by magic alone, weightless and unconnected to any other; the rest of the torso, the sides of the hips, the back, shoulders and arms are bare skin
notes: Shared angelic version of the sisters' celestial plate armor, coloured by the angel's own palette.
